answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Reaching the glacier of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. A quill of per-task receipts records who did what, and the willow of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, held in escrow until finality, no identity may audit its own recruit.
